title: DTScribe: Generating Models for Digital Twin Reporting using Local Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The development of a digital twin brings together many stakeholders and technical components. We have previously investigated the reporting of the conceptual architecture for these digital twins as an artifact for discussion. However, we find that the activity of modeling the digital twin for visualization and consensus-building can be quite tedious and time-consuming.   In this article, we explore the automation of model generation using large language models, targeting the model required for digital twin reporting. Our approach is designed to ingest digital twin documents and output both the conceptual architecture visualization and a reporting page for that digital twin. We first extract from the input the key details aligning with our twenty-one-characteristic Digital Twin Description Framework described in previous work. translated_title: DTScribe：使用本地大语言模型生成数字孪生报告模型
translated_abstract: 数字孪生的开发汇集了众多利益相关者和技术组件。我们此前曾研究过将数字孪生的概念架构报告作为讨论的工件。然而，我们发现为可视化和建立共识而对数字孪生进行建模的活动相当繁琐且耗时。在本文中，我们探索了使用大语言模型自动化生成模型的方法，目标是数字孪生报告所需的模型。我们的方法旨在摄取数字孪生文档，并输出该数字孪生的概念架构可视化和报告页面。我们首先从输入中提取与先前工作中描述的二十一特征数字孪生描述框架相一致的关键细节。然后，我们在本体建模语言中生成一个描述模型，将数字孪生表示为一个……
tldr: 本文提出DTScribe系统，利用本地大语言模型自动从数字孪生文档中提取关键信息，生成本体建模语言描述模型，实现数字孪生概念架构可视化与报告页面的自动化生成，解决了人工建模繁琐耗时的问题。
en_tdlr: DTScribe leverages local large language models to automatically extract key details from digital twin documents and generate Ontological Modeling Language description models, automating the creation of conceptual architecture visualizations and reporting pages to replace tedious manual modeling.
